games.blurb: No. 23 Clemson opens the season in Baton Rouge as a 10.5-point underdog to No. 13 LSU, and a total of 50.5 says oddsmakers expect defense to set the terms. It's the rare Week 1 game where both teams' ceilings are already on the line.
The Apple Cup kicks off the year with No. 19 Washington favored by 21.5 at home. Rivalry or not, the line suggests the Huskies are treating this like a tune-up.
Unranked Louisville heads to Oxford as just a 6.5-point underdog against No. 10 Ole Miss, with the total up at 55.5. That's a slim number for a top-10 host in Week 1.
No. 5 Notre Dame hosts Wisconsin and is favored by 20.5 with a modest 47.5 total. The Irish are expected to win comfortably without needing a shootout to do it.
The Border War opens the season with Colorado State favored by just four at home. Neither side is ranked, but a four-point rivalry line is the definition of a coin flip.
No. 16 Michigan opens at home as a 26.5-point favorite over Western Michigan. Little intrigue in the result, plenty in how the Wolverines look doing it.

predictions.blurb: Texas checks in at No. 4 with FPI slotting the Longhorns even higher at No. 2, so the numbers think this SEC contender is being slightly undersold.
Texas Tech sits 12th in the poll while FPI has the Red Raiders 10th, a rare case of the metrics and the voters landing in nearly the same place on a Big 12 favorite.
Michigan opens 16th with FPI a tick more bullish at No. 15, marking the Wolverines as a solid but not elite Big Ten entry.
BYU is ranked 15th but FPI puts the Cougars 20th, the widest gap of skepticism among the Big 12's ranked teams.
LSU starts 13th while FPI likes the Tigers at No. 9, suggesting the metrics see more in Baton Rouge than the poll does.
